stem: Which sentence best identifies Noi's central conflict?

options.label: A
options.text: Even though she was eleven years old, she liked to pretend that Kun Ya's creatures were real. (paragraph 8)

options.label: B
options.text: All morning, Noi and Ting had opened the umbrellas, getting them ready for Kun Ya's brush. (paragraph 10)

options.label: C
options.text: "But, Kun Ya, I don't know how." (paragraph 20)

options.label: D
options.text: "Your trembling is good, Noi," said Kun Ya. (paragraph 23)
